evidence_snippets: For scheduler configuration assets, such as BMC Control-M, Mainframe Assessment Tool provides AI-generated insights that help you visualize the scheduler workflow, including a listing of scheduled jobs, timelines for daily, weekly, or monthly schedules, and dependency graphs showing job relationships.

Dataset Fields: lists all fields within each dataset, along with their data types, start positions, sizes, key indicators, and other properties.
